Key.Original: Caps how many terminal lines are sent to nearby viewers. Higher values mirror more history but sharply increase bandwidth and can cause stutters; defaults are recommended.
Key.English: Caps how many terminal lines are sent to nearby viewers. Higher values mirror more history but sharply increase bandwidth and can cause stutters; defaults are recommended.
Key.French: Limite le nombre de lignes du terminal envoyées aux spectateurs proches. Des valeurs plus élevées répliquent plus d'historique mais augmentent fortement la bande passante et peuvent causer des saccades; les valeurs par défaut sont recommandées.
Key.Italian: Limita quante righe di terminale vengono inviate agli osservatori vicini. Valori più alti replicano più cronologia ma aumentano molto il traffico e possono causare scatti; si raccomanda il valore predefinito.
Key.Russian: Ограничивает число строк терминала, отправляемых близким игрокам. Более высокие значения передают больше истории, но резко увеличивают трафик и могут вызывать подтормаживания; рекомендуется оставлять значение по умолчанию.
Key.German: Begrenzt, wie viele Terminalzeilen an nahe Spieler gesendet werden. Höhere Werte spiegeln mehr Verlauf, erhöhen aber die Bandbreite stark und können Ruckler verursachen; Standardwerte werden empfohlen.
Key.Chinesesimp: 限制发送给附近玩家的终端行数。数值越高可显示更多历史，但会明显增加带宽并可能引起卡顿；建议使用默认值。

Key.French: Utilisation grep: 'grep -i -v MOTIF FICHIER...' affiche les lignes correspondant à l'expression régulière MOTIF. -i ignore la casse, -v inverse la correspondance.
Key.Italian: Utilizza grep: 'grep -i -v PATTERN FILE...' stampa le righe che corrispondono all'espressione regolare PATTERN. -i ignora maiuscole/minuscole, -v inverte la corrispondenza.
Key.Russian: Usage grep: 'grep -i -v PATTERN FILEPATH...' prints lines of the given files matching the regular expression PATTERN. -i ignores case, -v inverts the match.
Key.German: Verwendung grep: 'grep -i -v MUSTER DATEI...' gibt Zeilen aus, die dem regulären Ausdruck MUSTER entsprechen. -i ignoriert Groß-/Kleinschreibung, -v invertiert die Suche.
Key.Chinesesimp: grep说明:'grep -i -v 模式 文件...'打印匹配正则表达式的行.-i忽略大小写,-v反向匹配.

Key.Original: Usage history: 'history' lists last commands since the start of the computer.
Key.English: Usage history: 'history' lists last commands since the start of the computer.
Key.French: Utilisation history: 'history' répertorie les dernières commandes depuis le démarrage de l'ordinateur.
Key.Italian: Utilizzo history: 'history' mostra una lista di comandi dall'accensione del computer.
Key.Russian: Использование history: 'history' выдаёт списко команд которые вводились после включение компьютера
Key.German: Verwendung history: 'history' listet die letzten Befehle seit dem Start des Computers.
Key.Chinesesimp: history说明:'history'列出自计算机启动以来的最后一个命令.

Key.Original: Usage ip: 'ip' or 'ifconfig' returns the current ip configuration, 'ip r' additionally shows the gateway.
Key.English: Usage ip: 'ip' or 'ifconfig' returns the current ip configuration, 'ip r' additionally shows the gateway.
Key.French: Utilisation ip: 'ip' ou 'ifconfig' renvoie la configuration IP actuelle, 'ip r' affiche aussi la passerelle.
Key.Italian: Utilizza ip: 'ip' o 'ifconfig' mostra l'attuale configurazione ip, 'ip r' mostra anche il gateway.
Key.Russian: Usage ip: 'ip' or 'ifconfig' returns the current ip configuration, 'ip r' additionally shows the gateway.
Key.German: Verwendung ip: 'ip' oder 'ifconfig' liefert die aktuelle IP-Konfiguration zurück, 'ip r' zeigt zusätzlich das Gateway.
Key.Chinesesimp: ip说明:'ip'或'ifconfig'返回当前ip配置,'ip r'还会显示网关.

Key.Original: Display the content of a directory.
Key.English: Display the content of a directory.
Key.Italian: Mostra il contenuto di una directory.

Key.Original: Usage ls: 'ls [path]' returns a list of filesystem objects found in this path.
Key.English: Usage ls: 'ls [path]' returns a list of filesystem objects found in this path.
Key.French: Utilisation ls: 'ls [path]' renvoie une liste des objets du système de fichiers trouvés dans ce chemin d'accès.
Key.Italian: Utilizzo ls: 'ls [path]' mostra una lista di filesystem trovati in questo percorso.
Key.Russian: Использование ls: 'ls [path]' показывает список файлов найденных по этому пути
Key.German: Verwendung ls: 'ls [Pfad]' liefert eine Liste von in diesem Pfad gefundenen Dateisystemobjekten.
Key.Chinesesimp: ls说明:'ls[path]返回在此路径中找到的文件系统对象的列表.

Key.German: Zeigt die verfügbaren USB Ports an.

Key.French: Utilisation lsusb: 'lsusb' Liste les interfaces usb.
Key.Italian: Utilizzo lsusb: 'lsusb' lista delle interfacce USB.
Key.German: Verwendung lsusb: 'lsusb' zeigt die USB Ports an.

Key.Original: Prints usage information about a command.
Key.English: Prints usage information about a command.
Key.French: Affiche les informations d'utilisation d'une commande.
Key.Italian: Mostra informazioni su utilizzo del comando.
Key.German: Gibt Informationen zur Benutzung eines Befehls aus.

Key.Original: Usage man: 'man [command]' returns usage information for the command.
Key.English: Usage man: 'man [command]' returns usage information for the command.
Key.French: Utilisation man: 'man [command]' renvoie les informations d'utilisation de la commande.
Key.Italian: Utilizzo man: 'man [command]' mostra informazioni sull'utilizzo del comando.
Key.Russian: Использование man: 'man [command]' выводит информацию об использовании команды
Key.German: Verwendung man: 'man [Befehl]' liefert Informationen zur Benutzung des Befehls zurück.
Key.Chinesesimp: man说明:'man[command]'返回命令说明信息.

Key.Original: Usage mkdir: 'mkdir [path]' creates a new folder/directory.
Key.English: Usage mkdir: 'mkdir [path]' creates a new folder/directory.
Key.French: Utilisation mkdir: 'mkdir [répertoire]' crée un nouveau dossier/répertoire.
Key.Italian: utilizza mkdir: 'mkdir [path]' crea una nuova cartlla o directory.
Key.Russian: Использование mkdir: 'mkdir [path]' создаёт новый файл или директорию
Key.German: Verwendung mkdir: 'mkdir [Pfad]' erstellt ein neues Verzeichnis/Ordner.
Key.Chinesesimp: mkdir说明:'mkdir [path]'创建新目录或文件夹

Key.Original: Mounts a flash drive in the specified usb port.
Key.English: Mounts a flash drive in the specified usb port.
Key.French: Monte un lecteur flash dans le port USB spécifié.
Key.Italian: Monta una chiavetta USB nella specifica porta USB.
Key.Russian: Подключает флэш-накопитель к указанному порту USB.
Key.German: Hängt einen USB Stick in den gegebenen USB Port ein.
Key.Chinesesimp: 在指定的usb端口装载一个闪盘驱动器.

Key.Original: Usage mount: 'mount [interface name]' mounts given interface.
Key.English: Usage mount: 'mount [interface name]' mounts given interface.
Key.French: Utilisation mount: 'mount [nom interface]' monte l'interface donnée.
Key.Italian: Utilizzo mount: 'mount [interface name]' monta l'interfaccia indicata.
Key.Russian: Использование mount: 'mount [interface name]' подключает usb-накопитель к заданному порту.
Key.German: Verwendung mount: 'mount [Name]' hängt den USB Stick in den gegebenen Port ein.
Key.Chinesesimp: mount说明: 'mount [interface name]' 装载给定的接口.

Key.Original: Send an instant message to another computer.
Key.English: Send an instant message to another computer.
Key.French: Envoie un message instantané à un autre ordinateur.
Key.Italian: Invia un messaggio istantaneo a un altro computer.
Key.Russian: Send an instant message to another computer.
Key.German: Sendet eine Sofortnachricht an einen anderen Computer.
Key.Chinesesimp: 向另一台计算机发送即时消息.

Key.Original: Usage msg: 'msg TARGET-IP MESSAGE...' sends a message over the network. Received messages are stored in /var/mail/inbox (read with cat).
Key.English: Usage msg: 'msg TARGET-IP MESSAGE...' sends a message over the network. Received messages are stored in /var/mail/inbox (read with cat).
Key.French: Utilisation msg: 'msg IP-CIBLE MESSAGE...' envoie un message via le réseau. Les messages reçus sont stockés dans /var/mail/inbox.
Key.Italian: Utilizza msg: 'msg IP-DESTINAZIONE MESSAGGIO...' invia un messaggio via rete. I messaggi ricevuti sono in /var/mail/inbox.
Key.Russian: Usage msg: 'msg TARGET-IP MESSAGE...' sends a message over the network. Received messages are stored in /var/mail/inbox.
Key.German: Verwendung msg: 'msg ZIEL-IP NACHRICHT...' sendet eine Nachricht über das Netzwerk. Empfangene Nachrichten stehen in /var/mail/inbox.
Key.Chinesesimp: msg说明:'msg 目标IP 消息...'通过网络发送消息.收到的消息存储在/var/mail/inbox中.

Key.French: Déplace un fichier ou un dossier.
Key.Italian: Muovi un file o una cartella.
Key.German: Verschiebt eine Datei oder ein Verzeichnis.

Key.Original: Usage mv: 'mv [old path] [new path]' moves file to new path or renames the file.
Key.English: Usage mv: 'mv [old path] [new path]' moves file to new path or renames the file.
Key.French: Utilisation mv: 'mv [ancien chemin d'accès] [nouveau chemin d'accès]' déplace le fichier vers un nouveau chemin d'accès ou renomme le fichier.
Key.Italian: Utilizzo mv: 'mv [old path] [new path]' muove un file su un nuovo percorso o lo rinominae.
Key.Russian: Использование mv: "mv [old path] [new path] Перемещает файл или папку или переименовывает
Key.German: Verwendung mv: 'mv [alter Pfad] [neuer Pfad]' verschiebt eine Datei zum neuen Pfad oder benennt die Datei um.
Key.Chinesesimp: mv说明:'mv[old path] [new path]'将文件移动到新路径或重命名文件.

Key.Original: Usage ping: 'ping [address]' pings the given address.
Key.English: Usage ping: 'ping [address]' pings the given address.
Key.German: Verwendung ping: 'ping [Adresse]' pingt die angegebene Adresse.

Key.Original: Usage rm: 'rm [path]' deletes a file at the given path.
Key.English: Usage rm: 'rm [path]' deletes a file at the given path.
Key.French: Utilisation rm: 'rm [chemin d'accès]' supprime un fichier au chemin d'accès donné.
Key.Italian: Utilizzo rm: 'rm [path]' rimuove un file dal percorso indiao.
Key.Russian: Использование rm: 'rm [path]' удаляет файл по указанному пути.
Key.German: Verwendung rm: 'rm [Pfad]' entfernt eine Datei am angegebenen Pfad.
Key.Chinesesimp: rm说明:'rm[path]'删除指定路径上的文件.

Key.Original: Usage shutdown: 'shutdown' turns off the computer.
Key.English: Usage shutdown: 'shutdown' turns off the computer.
Key.German: Verwendung shutdown: 'shutdown' schaltet den Computer aus.

Key.Original: Retro Snake Game - use option --big for doubled block size
Key.English: Retro Snake Game - use option --big for doubled block size
Key.French: Jeu Rétro Snake - utilisez l'option --big pour doubler la taille des blocs
Key.Italian: Retro Snake Game - usa opzione --grande per dimensione blocco doppia
Key.Russian: Retro Snake Game - use option --big for doubled block size
Key.German: Retro Spiel Snake - benutze die Option --big für eine doppelte Blockgröße
Key.Chinesesimp: 贪吃蛇 - 使用参数 --big 使区块大小翻倍

Key.Original: Open a remote shell session on another computer.
Key.English: Open a remote shell session on another computer.
Key.French: Ouvre une session shell distante sur un autre ordinateur.
Key.Italian: Apre una sessione shell remota su un altro computer.
Key.Russian: Open a remote shell session on another computer.
Key.German: Öffnet eine entfernte Shell-Sitzung auf einem anderen Computer.
Key.Chinesesimp: 在另一台计算机上打开远程shell会话.

Key.Original: Usage ssh: 'ssh USER@IP PASSWORD' connects to the remote computer. Entered commands run on the remote machine; 'exit' ends the session. Interactive programs are blocked.
Key.English: Usage ssh: 'ssh USER@IP PASSWORD' connects to the remote computer. Entered commands run on the remote machine; 'exit' ends the session. Interactive programs are blocked.
Key.French: Utilisation ssh: 'ssh UTILISATEUR@IP MOTDEPASSE' se connecte à l'ordinateur distant. Les commandes s'exécutent sur la machine distante ; 'exit' termine la session.
Key.Italian: Utilizza ssh: 'ssh UTENTE@IP PASSWORD' si connette al computer remoto. I comandi vengono eseguiti sulla macchina remota; 'exit' termina la sessione.
Key.Russian: Usage ssh: 'ssh USER@IP PASSWORD' connects to the remote computer. Entered commands run on the remote machine; 'exit' ends the session.
Key.German: Verwendung ssh: 'ssh BENUTZER@IP PASSWORT' verbindet mit dem entfernten Computer. Befehle laufen auf der entfernten Maschine; 'exit' beendet die Sitzung.
Key.Chinesesimp: ssh说明:'ssh 用户@IP 密码'连接到远程计算机.输入的命令在远程计算机上运行;'exit'结束会话.

Key.Original: Puts the computer in standby mode.
Key.English: Puts the computer in standby mode.
Key.German: Versetzt den Computer in den Ruhezustand.

Key.Original: Usage standby: 'standby' activates the computers standby mode.
Key.English: Usage standby: 'standby' activates the computers standby mode.
Key.French: Utilisation standby: 'standby' active le mode veille de l'ordinateur.
Key.Italian: utilizza standby: 'standby' attiva il computer in modalità standby.
Key.Russian: Использование standby: 'standby' переводит компьютер в режим ожидания
Key.German: Verwendung standby: 'standby' aktiviert den Ruhezustand des Computers.

Key.Original: Usage su: 'su [USER]' switches the session to USER, or to root when no account is given. The current user must be root or listed in /etc/sudoers. Use exit to return to the previous account.
Key.English: Usage su: 'su [USER]' switches the session to USER, or to root when no account is given. The current user must be root or listed in /etc/sudoers. Use exit to return to the previous account.
Key.French: Utilisation su: 'su [UTILISATEUR]' change la session vers UTILISATEUR, ou vers root si aucun compte n'est indiqué. L'utilisateur doit être root ou figurer dans /etc/sudoers. Utilisez exit pour revenir au compte précédent.
Key.Italian: Utilizza su: 'su [UTENTE]' passa la sessione a UTENTE, o a root se non viene indicato un account. L'utente deve essere root o essere elencato in /etc/sudoers. Usa exit per tornare all'account precedente.
Key.Russian: Usage su: 'su [USER]' switches the session to USER, or to root when no account is given. The current user must be root or listed in /etc/sudoers. Use exit to return to the previous account.
Key.German: Verwendung su: 'su [BENUTZER]' wechselt die Sitzung zu BENUTZER, ohne Angabe zu root. Der Benutzer muss root sein oder in /etc/sudoers stehen. Mit exit geht es zum vorherigen Konto zurück.
Key.Chinesesimp: su说明:'su [用户]'将会话切换到该用户,未指定时切换到root.当前用户必须是root或在/etc/sudoers中.使用exit返回上一个账户.

Key.French: Exécute une commande en tant que root.
Key.German: Führt einen Befehl als root aus.

Key.Original: Usage sudo: 'sudo COMMAND ARGS...' executes the command as root. The current user must be listed in /etc/sudoers.
Key.English: Usage sudo: 'sudo COMMAND ARGS...' executes the command as root. The current user must be listed in /etc/sudoers.
Key.French: Utilisation sudo: 'sudo COMMANDE ARGS...' exécute la commande en tant que root. L'utilisateur doit figurer dans /etc/sudoers.
Key.Italian: Utilizza sudo: 'sudo COMANDO ARG...' esegue il comando come root. L'utente deve essere elencato in /etc/sudoers.
Key.Russian: Usage sudo: 'sudo COMMAND ARGS...' executes the command as root. The current user must be listed in /etc/sudoers.
Key.German: Verwendung sudo: 'sudo BEFEHL ARGS...' führt den Befehl als root aus. Der Benutzer muss in /etc/sudoers stehen.
Key.Chinesesimp: sudo说明:'sudo 命令 参数...'以root身份执行命令.当前用户必须在/etc/sudoers中.

Key.Original: Usage touch: 'touch [filename]' creates an empty file with the given name.
Key.English: Usage touch: 'touch [filename]' creates an empty file with the given name.
Key.French: Utilisation touch: 'touch [nom de fichier]' crée un fichier vide avec le nom donné.
Key.Italian: Utilizzo touch: 'touch [filename]' crea un file vuoto con il nome indicato.
Key.Russian: Использование touch: 'touch [filename]' создаёт пустой файл с заданным именем
Key.German: Verwendung touch: 'touch [Dateiname]' erstellt eine leere Datei mit dem gegebenen Namen.
Key.Chinesesimp: touch说明:'touch [filename]'创建指定名称的空文件.

Key.Original: Unmounts a flash drive from the specified usb port.
Key.English: Unmounts a flash drive from the specified usb port.
Key.French: Ejecte un lecteur flash du port USB spécifié.
Key.Italian: Smonta una chiavetta USB da una specifica porta usb.
Key.German: Hängt einen USB Stick aus dem gegebenen USB Port aus.
Key.Chinesesimp: 在指定的usb端口卸载闪盘驱动器.

Key.Original: Usage umount: 'umount [interface name]' unmounts given interface.
Key.English: Usage umount: 'umount [interface name]' unmounts given interface.
Key.French: Utilisation umount: 'umount [nom interface]' ejecte l'interface spécifié.
Key.Italian: Utilizzo umount: 'umount [interface name]' smonta l'interfaccia indicata.
Key.Russian: Использование umount: 'umount [interface name]' отключает usb-накопитель от заданного порта
Key.German: Verwendung umount: 'umount [Name]' hängt USB Stick in gegebenem Port aus.
Key.Chinesesimp: umount说明: 'umount [interface name]'卸载给定的接口.

Key.French: Ouvre un fichier protégé par mot de passe.
Key.Italian: Apre un file protetto da password.
Key.Chinesesimp: 打开受密码保护的文件.

Key.Original: Usage unlock: 'unlock FILEPATH PASSWORD' prints the protected content. 'unlock -p FILEPATH PASSWORD' permanently removes the protection (requires write permission).
Key.English: Usage unlock: 'unlock FILEPATH PASSWORD' prints the protected content. 'unlock -p FILEPATH PASSWORD' permanently removes the protection (requires write permission).
Key.French: Utilisation unlock : 'unlock FICHIER MOTDEPASSE' affiche le contenu protégé. 'unlock -p FICHIER MOTDEPASSE' supprime définitivement la protection.
Key.Italian: Utilizzo unlock: 'unlock FILE PASSWORD' stampa il contenuto protetto. 'unlock -p FILE PASSWORD' rimuove definitivamente la protezione.
Key.Russian: Usage unlock: 'unlock FILEPATH PASSWORD' prints the protected content. 'unlock -p FILEPATH PASSWORD' permanently removes the protection.
Key.German: Verwendung unlock: 'unlock DATEI PASSWORT' gibt den geschützten Inhalt aus. 'unlock -p DATEI PASSWORT' entfernt den Schutz dauerhaft.
Key.Chinesesimp: unlock说明:'unlock 文件 密码'打印受保护的内容.'unlock -p 文件 密码'永久移除保护.

Key.Original: Usage whoami: 'whoami' returns the current user.
Key.English: Usage whoami: 'whoami' returns the current user.
Key.German: Verwendung whoami: 'whoami' liefert den aktuellen Benutzer zurück.

Key.Original: The 'snake' game. Eat fruits while getting longer and longer. Don't collide with yourself or the walls.
Key.English: The 'snake' game. Eat fruits while getting longer and longer. Don't collide with yourself or the walls.
Key.French: Le jeu du "serpent". Mangez des fruits en devenant de plus en plus long. N'entrez pas en collision avec vous-même ou les murs.
Key.Italian: Il gioco 'snake'. mangia i frutti mentre diventa sempre più lungo. non scontrarti con te stesso o con i muri.
Key.Russian: The 'snake' game. Eat fruits while getting longer and longer. Don't collide with yourself or the walls.
Key.German: Das 'snake' Spiel. Iss Früchte während du immer länger wirst. Vermeide mit der Wand oder dir selbst zu kollidieren.
Key.Chinesesimp: The 'snake' game. Eat fruits while getting longer and longer. Don't collide with yourself or the walls.

Key.Original: This module gives an existing account superuser rights on an armaOS computer by adding it to /etc/sudoers. Sync one or more of these modules to a supported computer.
Key.English: This module gives an existing account superuser rights on an armaOS computer by adding it to /etc/sudoers. Sync one or more of these modules to a supported computer.

Key.Original: This module defines users for an armaOS computer. Simply sync one or more of these modules to a supported computer.
Key.English: This module defines users for an armaOS computer. Simply sync one or more of these modules to a supported computer.
Key.French: Ce module définit les utilisateurs pour un ordinateur armaOS. Synchronisez simplement un ou plusieurs de ces modules avec un ordinateur pris en charge.
Key.Italian: Questo definisce gli utenti per i computer armaOS. Semplicemente sincronizza uno o più di questi moduli a computer supportati.
Key.Russian: Этот модуль определяет пользователей для компьютера с armaOS. Просто синхронизируйте один или несколько из этих модулей с поддерживаемым компьютером.
Key.German: Dieses Modul definiert Benutzer für einen armaOS Computer. Synchronisiere einfach ein oder mehrere dieser Module mit einem unterstützten Computer.
Key.Chinesesimp: 此模块定义armaOS计算机的用户.只需将这些模块中的一个或多个同步到指定的计算机.

Key.Original: Overwrites the synced laptop with the data stored under the named save slot, replacing a laptop that was lost or disabled.
Key.English: Overwrites the synced laptop with the data stored under the named save slot, replacing a laptop that was lost or disabled.

Key.Original: Captures all of the synced laptop's data (files, users, calendar, emails, network settings) into the named save slot.
Key.English: Captures all of the synced laptop's data (files, users, calendar, emails, network settings) into the named save slot.

Key.Original: Password of authorized user, for example '123456', 'password' or 'Qf5:xxR12#fTG'
Key.English: Password of authorized user, for example '123456', 'password' or 'Qf5:xxR12#fTG'
Key.French: Mot de passe de l'utilisateur autorisé, par exemple '123456', 'password' ou 'Qf5:xxR12#fTG'
Key.Italian: Password di un utente autorizzato, per esempio '123456', 'password' o 'Qf5:xxR12#fTG'
Key.Russian: Пароль для авторизации пользователя, например '123456', 'password' или 'Qf5:xxR12#fTG'
Key.German: Kennwort eines authorisierten Benutzers, zum Beispiel '123456', 'password' oder 'Qf5:xxR12#fTG'

Key.Original: Name of the slot the laptop snapshot is stored under. Use the same name on the Restore Laptop module.
Key.English: Name of the slot the laptop snapshot is stored under. Use the same name on the Restore Laptop module.

Key.Original: Name of an existing account that gets superuser rights, for example 'admin' or 'stavros'
Key.English: Name of an existing account that gets superuser rights, for example 'admin' or 'stavros'

Key.Original: Name of authorized user, for example 'admin', 'guest' or 'stavros'
Key.English: Name of authorized user, for example 'admin', 'guest' or 'stavros'
Key.French: Nom de l'utilisateur autorisé, par exemple 'admin', 'guest' ou 'stavros'
Key.Italian: Nome di un utente autorizzato, per esempio 'admin', 'guest' o 'stavros'
Key.German: Name eines authorisierten Benutzers, zum Beispiel 'admin', 'guest' oder 'stavros'
Key.Chinesesimp: 授权用户的名称,例如'admin','guest'或'stavros'.

Key.Original: Which interfaces this laptop offers. Default uses the AE3_Desktop_DefaultMode CBA setting. Per-player access is controlled by the mission maker (AE3_desktop_fnc_setInterfaceAccess).
Key.English: Which interfaces this laptop offers. Default uses the AE3_Desktop_DefaultMode CBA setting. Per-player access is controlled by the mission maker (AE3_desktop_fnc_setInterfaceAccess).
Key.French: Interfaces offertes par cet ordinateur. Default utilise le paramètre CBA AE3_Desktop_DefaultMode. L'accès par joueur est contrôlé par le créateur de mission.
Key.Italian: Quali interfacce offre questo laptop. Default usa l'impostazione CBA AE3_Desktop_DefaultMode. L'accesso per giocatore è controllato dal mission maker.
Key.Russian: Which interfaces this laptop offers. Default uses the AE3_Desktop_DefaultMode CBA setting.
Key.German: Welche Oberflächen dieser Laptop anbietet. Default nutzt die CBA-Einstellung AE3_Desktop_DefaultMode. Der Zugriff pro Spieler wird vom Missionsbauer gesteuert.
Key.Chinesesimp: 此笔记本电脑提供的界面.Default使用AE3_Desktop_DefaultMode CBA设置.每个玩家的访问权限由任务制作者控制.

Key.Original: Whether root may log in directly on this laptop. Default follows the AE3_AllowRootLogin CBA setting; users listed as sudoers can always use the sudo command instead.
Key.English: Whether root may log in directly on this laptop. Default follows the AE3_AllowRootLogin CBA setting; users listed as sudoers can always use the sudo command instead.

Key.Original: Password of this laptop's root account. Leave blank to use the default root password from the CBA settings.
Key.English: Password of this laptop's root account. Leave blank to use the default root password from the CBA settings.

Key.Original: Assign a fixed IP address. Leave blank to use DHCP from the connected router. Format: 192.168.1.5
Key.English: Assign a fixed IP address. Leave blank to use DHCP from the connected router. Format: 192.168.1.5

Key.Original: Accounts that may run the sudo command and get superuser rights in the desktop apps. The accounts must exist on the laptop. Format: analyst, cracked
Key.English: Accounts that may run the sudo command and get superuser rights in the desktop apps. The accounts must exist on the laptop. Format: analyst, cracked

Key.Original: ssh: a session is already active - end it with 'exit' first
Key.English: ssh: a session is already active - end it with 'exit' first
Key.French: ssh : une session est déjà active - terminez-la d'abord avec 'exit'
Key.Italian: ssh: una sessione è già attiva - terminala prima con 'exit'
Key.Russian: ssh: a session is already active - end it with 'exit' first
Key.German: ssh: Es ist bereits eine Sitzung aktiv - zuerst mit 'exit' beenden
Key.Chinesesimp: ssh: 会话已激活 - 请先使用'exit'结束

Key.Original: %1: cannot be run over ssh (interactive program)
Key.English: %1: cannot be run over ssh (interactive program)
Key.French: %1 : ne peut pas être exécuté via ssh (programme interactif)
Key.Italian: %1: non può essere eseguito via ssh (programma interattivo)
Key.Russian: %1: cannot be run over ssh (interactive program)
Key.German: %1: kann nicht über ssh ausgeführt werden (interaktives Programm)
Key.Chinesesimp: %1: 无法通过ssh运行(交互式程序)

Key.Original: Connected as %1@%2 - end the session with 'exit'
Key.English: Connected as %1@%2 - end the session with 'exit'
Key.French: Connecté en tant que %1@%2 - terminez la session avec 'exit'
Key.Italian: Connesso come %1@%2 - termina la sessione con 'exit'
Key.Russian: Connected as %1@%2 - end the session with 'exit'
Key.Chinesesimp: 已连接为%1@%2 - 使用'exit'结束会话

Key.Original: Connection to %1 closed by remote host.
Key.English: Connection to %1 closed by remote host.

Key.Original: ssh: connect to host %1: Connection refused
Key.English: ssh: connect to host %1: Connection refused
Key.French: ssh : connexion à l'hôte %1 : connexion refusée
Key.Russian: ssh: connect to host %1: Connection refused
Key.German: ssh: Verbindung zu Host %1: Verbindung abgelehnt
Key.Chinesesimp: ssh: 连接主机%1: 连接被拒绝

Key.Original: ssh: connect to host %1: No route to host
